description: LLM-as-judge evaluator. Pass-through asset that takes an upstream agent / LLM output and scores it on configurable feedbacks (answer_relevance, groundedness, context_relevance, harmfulness, helpfulness, coherence). Same conceptual model as TruLens — without the framework dep.

outputs.description: Upstream payload + 'evaluations' field containing per-metric score (0.0-1.0) and reason.

include_reasoning.label: Include Reasoning
include_reasoning.description: Reasoning models (Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, ...) inline <think>...</think>. The thinking is always stripped before SCORE/REASON are parsed; when true each entry of the 'evaluations' output gains a 'reasoning' key with the judge's thinking.

upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset to evaluate (typically an *_agent or LLM output).
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

evaluations.label: Evaluations
evaluations.description: Which feedbacks to compute. Valid: answer_relevance, groundedness, context_relevance, harmfulness, helpfulness, coherence.

api_key_env_var.description: Env var with the judge LLM's API key.
api_key_env_var.label: Judge API Key Env Var

temperature.description: Judge sampling temperature (keep low for consistent scoring).
temperature.label: Temperature

answer_jsonpath.label: Answer Path
answer_jsonpath.description: Dot-path in upstream to the answer string. Default 'final_answer' (matches *_agent output).

question_jsonpath.label: Question Path
question_jsonpath.description: Dot-path to the question. If unset, pulls first user message from upstream's transcript.

context_jsonpath.label: Context Path
context_jsonpath.description: Dot-path to retrieved context (for groundedness / context_relevance).

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter upstream rows to the current date partition (time partitions).
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter upstream rows to the current static/dynamic partition key.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.
